assertions.name: the_block_assembly_reproduces_the_independent_trace
assertions.source: worst |sum_lambda y_lambda chi_lambda(pair) - tr_M(pair)| = 2.60595e-50 over 5 pairs, including pairs whose letters are NOT braid generators (d = -1/2 and d = -1). This validates two things at once: the linearity expansion of chi_lambda(sigma_a + d_a h)(sigma_b + d_b h), and the convention-D weights y_lambda. Two independent engines -- the seminormal mpfr character kernel and the normal-form trace -- agreeing to this tolerance is evidence the decomposition is the corpus's own, not a re-derivation that happens to be close

assertions.name: convention_D_kills_the_alternating_block_and_normalises_the_identity
assertions.source: y_(1^3) = 0 exactly -- that vanishing IS convention D (D => vanish is threeRow_eq_zero_of_jones_ocneanu; the converse is markovWeights_eq_jones_of_threeRow_eq_zero + hfaith), not a truncation applied here -- and sum_lambda y_lambda dim_lambda = 1.0 recovers tr_M(1) = 1. So the cost vector has a structurally zero column at n = 3 and is effectively 2-dimensional. A reader seeing that zero should know it is the convention

assertions.name: the_block_cost_vectors_reconstruct_the_scalar_and_separate
assertions.source: 4 distinct totals over 4 candidates, each total being sum_lambda t_lambda -- the Lean identity total_eq_sum_blockCosts realised numerically. So the vector is a refinement of the separating scalar and not a different quantity, which is what makes it admissible in the `cost : W -> R` socket while carrying strictly more information than the scalar does

assertions.name: the_vector_carries_information_the_scalar_does_not
assertions.source: measured on these four: 0 candidate pairs share a total, so on THIS family the scalar already separates and the refinement is not needed. Stated plainly rather than omitted -- blockVector_strictly_finer_than_total proves the vector CAN carry more, and that is a general fact; it does not assert that it does so here. What the vector buys on this family is not extra separation but the right TYPE for the LP, whose objective min sum_lambda t_lambda x_lambda reads the components and not the total

assertions.name: all_the_separation_lives_in_the_mixed_symmetry_block
assertions.source: t_(3) takes ONE value across all four candidates (8.6760259262744171317) while t_(2,1) takes 4 distinct values. The trivial block is blind here and the alternating block is identically zero under convention D, so the whole discriminating content of this cost sits in the mixed-symmetry block. Worth recording because that is the SAME block the 2026-09-13 reading-3 ruling binds on: `nuc11_interleaved` fails Frobenius positivity on (2,1), and `y_(2,1) > 0` is what makes that failure bind. Cost and constraint are therefore carried by one block. This is an observation about where the information is, NOT a claim that the two are the same condition or that either determines the other

description: Computes the per-block cost vector t_lambda of the discretised E_cat pair kernel, closing the step between a separating scalar and the vector the operator-selection LP/SDP takes. chi_lambda of a letter pair is obtained EXACTLY by linearity -- a letter sigma + d h I is not a braid word for d != 0, and expanding the product gives four seminormal characters of braid words of length <= 2. The assembly is VERIFIED, not assumed: sum_lambda y_lambda chi_lambda(pair) is reassembled and compared against the independent tr_at engine. Under convention D y_(1^3) = 0, so the alternating block contributes nothing and the vector is effectively 2-dimensional at n = 3. Selects no word and runs no LP.

method.chi_of_a_letter_pair: exact by linearity: chi(s_a s_b) + d_b h chi(s_a) + d_a h chi(s_b) + d_a d_b h^2 dim
method.why_needed: a letter sigma + d h I is not a braid word for d != 0; d = -1 is sigma^{-1}, d = -1/2 the bar-fixed letter

scope.class: (a) scope-limited -- one discretisation, four candidates, n = 3, proton
not_claimed: that this is E_cat -- it is the per-block refinement of a DISCRETISATION whose continuum limit is unproved
that any word is selected -- no LP is run here
that this cost should be adopted; that is an owner decision (qou-99qc)
scope.no_selection_by_accuracy: no Q_beta, no CODATA, no residual
